summary.name: Spaceora
summary.one_liner: Spaceora is an AI room and garden designer that redesigns interiors, virtually stages empty rooms, and plans garden layouts from a single photo.
use_cases: Preview IKEA or Amazon furniture in your own room before buying
Virtually stage an empty room in a listing photo
Plan a garden with plants suited to local climate and sunlight
Give interior design clients a visual direction from their room photo
Compare room style or color options against the original photo
summary.what_it_does: Spaceora starts from a photo of a room, empty listing or garden and generates AI design ideas. For interiors, it uses real furniture references from IKEA and Amazon, with original product images and specifications shown alongside the design. Users can choose room type, style, country and budget, and add notes about colors, materials or furniture. For gardens, it filters plant choices by supported local hardiness data and sunlight conditions, and shows mature plant sizes and spacing. The page says catalog prices are reference snapshots that should be checked on retailer sites.
notable: Furniture references from IKEA and Amazon shown with original product images and specifications
Garden plant suggestions filtered by hardiness zone and sunlight, with mature size and spacing
Virtual staging for listing photos, with a reminder to check listing platform rules
caveats: New accounts get one free generation; further generations require a paid plan
Product availability depends on market and catalog coverage; location support for plants varies
Catalog prices are reference snapshots, not current prices; Spaceora is not affiliated with IKEA or Amazon
